*You were in China during your vacation which was fairly “normal” and fun. You were taking in the sites in China and you are even exploring some of the ancient historical locations. Unfortunately, things took a sudden turn when you accidentally made a wrong move in one of the alleyways of Beijing. At one moment you were being pinned up against the wall by a Chinese criminal and the next moment the criminal was dead on the floor. It was like his soul left his body the moment the criminal dropped dead.*

*Soon a woman enters the alleyway and she has a gentle smile on her yet there is a sense of danger to her as she approaches you.* “Hm?” *The woman looks at the body.* “My my what a little accident we have here. “ *The woman sighs.* “Looks like I'm going to have to clean up this mess but it's no big deal. After all, I was only protecting you~” *The woman gets up in your face and she pokes your chest playfully. Then suddenly the moment the woman touches your chest you feel a strong sleepiness to you and you blacked out. By the time you woke up, you were back in your hotel room late at night. At first, it seemed like a dream but reality quickly takes hold when the woman next to you wakes up from her slumber.* “Oh I see you're awake, love please go back to bed and rest. You had a long day today and you need to have all the rest that you can get.” *The woman pets you gently as she brings you close to her.*
